title: Shania Twain calls for equal pay and more diversity in country music
content: Shania Twian is standing up for others in country music.

title: Battlefield Picture Worsening for Ukraine as Trump Pushes Peace Plan
content: Russian forces have advanced on several fronts recently. President Vladimir V. Putin signaled after talks with U.S. officials that he was not budging from demands.

title: Saudi Arabia Will Sell You Alcohol Now, if You’re Rich Enough
content: The conservative Islamic kingdom’s approach to social policy change is often silence and ambiguity. Legalizing alcohol has been no different.

title: Afrikaner Access Soars Amid Trump’s Policy Shift
content: The white descendants of Europeans who colonized the country are getting greater access to American officials this year, both in Washington and in Pretoria.

title: Survivors of the Deadly Hong Kong Fire Are in Limbo
content: Hong Kong, with some of the world’s highest housing costs and inequality, must now figure out how to help thousands of residents who lost friends, family and homes.

title: China’s Mad at Japan, and Pop Stars Are Paying for It
content: Beijing is curbing Japanese movies, music and art as it seeks to punish Tokyo for its support of Taiwan.

title: Zelensky’s Government Sabotaged Oversight, Allowing Corruption in Ukraine to Fester
content: Ukrainian leaders blame independent advisers for failing to prevent graft. A Times investigation found that President Volodymyr Zelensky’s own administration removed guardrails.

title: The ‘Cocaine Superhighway’ Fueled by the U.S. Focus on Fentanyl
content: As Washington made combating fentanyl a priority, cocaine trafficking has surged. Nowhere have the ripples been felt like in Ecuador, where criminal groups have run rampant.

title: Gianni Infantino Awards Trump a FIFA Peace Prize and Announces World Cup Draw
content: Gianni Infantino, head of soccer’s governing body, has been ingratiating himself with the president to help ensure a successful 2026 World Cup.

title: U.S. Warns of Europe’s ‘Civilizational Erasure’ Through Immigration
content: America’s goal should be “to help Europe correct its current trajectory,” the administration said in its new National Security Strategy.

title: Putin Basks in Praise From Modi on India Visit
content: Prime Minister Narendra Modi lauded President Vladimir V. Putin of Russia, underlining the close personal relationship between the leaders and their countries’ longtime friendship.

title: Yemen’s Civil War Could Escalate Again. Here’s What to Know.
content: An armed group backed by the United Arab Emirates has pushed into the oil-rich province of Hadramout, a move that could reignite conflict in Yemen after years of a stalemate.

title: On Pope Leo’s Visit to Lebanon and Turkey, A.I. Was a Frequent Concern
content: On his first trip as pontiff, Leo XIV predictably called for peace and unity. But he also addressed technology’s promise and pitfalls.

title: Wary of Russia, German Defense Minister Pistorius Is Growing His Army
content: Boris Pistorius, Germany’s defense minister, is pushing to expand its military in case tensions with Russia escalate. That’s tricky in a country where the Nazi era casts a long shadow.

title: China’s National Security Office in Hong Kong Summons Foreign Journalists
content: The authorities accused “some foreign media” of smearing the government’s response to a fire at a high-rise complex, saying: “Do not say you have not been warned.”
